content:
julian_sales: Heads up — Helios Data dropped a CAIQ + custom control addendum. They want answers + evidence before we sign the SOW. POC starts next week. Can someone take owner and give an ETA?

omar_security: I can pick this up. Do we know target deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) and any special compliance asks?

julian_sales: Private VPC, plus they require BYOK + 12mo immutable audit logs and FedRAMP-style control mappings for a couple items. Tight ask: they want initial responses within 48 hours.

omar_security: Assigned to me. Created ticket REDWOOD-SEC-4899 and tagged `helios-data`. Need these from infra/POC to complete answers:
```text
- concrete steps for BYOK import + rotation (private)
- list of log types exported to customer SIEM and retention options
- sample Data Processing Addendum (DPA) excerpt
- diagram of where plaintext is handled (if any) and KV cache behavior
- SOC2 cert link or SOC2 audit letter excerpt
```

infra_poc: I'll generate the diagram and a short BYOK playbook by EOD today. FYI BYOK for private uses our partner HSM flow; sample snippet attached.

infra_poc: ```bash
# BYOK import (private env)
redwoodctl kms create --name helios-byo --hsm-endpoint hsm.partner.example --policy rotation=90d --env private
redwoodctl kms import-key --file /tmp/helios_pub.pem --kms helios-byo
```

legal_review_bot: Reminder: any encryption claims that mention "FIPS-validated module" require legal+compliance review. Mark items accordingly in REDWOOD-SEC-4899.

omar_security: Noted — I'll flag FIPS and third-party attestation items. julian_sales, can you confirm whether Helios wants the SOC2 attestation redacted or full?

julian_sales: They asked for a redacted SOC2 report first, then full under NDA. I'll attach their NDA to the ticket.

finance_ops: Pricing note — Private + BYOK + 12mo immutable logs will add both committed capacity and storage uplift. Ballpark uplift: +20% on committed GPU baseline + $0.02/GB/mo additional for immutable logs. I'll add a quick calc to the ticket.

omar_security: Great. Workflow plan:
1) infra_poc uploads diagram + BYOK steps to REDWOOD-SEC-4899 (evidence folder)
2) I draft CAIQ responses re: KeyMgmt, Logging, Retention, IncidentResponse, AccessControls
3) Mark ~2 questions for legal review (FIPS/attestation wording)
4) Sales sends redacted SOC2 after NDA is countersigned
5) Finance attaches SOW uplift estimate

julian_sales: Timeline workable? If you can get draft answers within 36 hours we can keep the SOW target.

infra_poc: Uploaded dataflow diagram and BYOK playbook to the ticket: https://redwoodinternal.docs/helios/caqi-4899/evidence. Also included sample HSM command outputs.

omar_security: Drafted responses pushed to REDWOOD-SEC-4899 (answers v0.1). Marked two items `needs_legal` (FIPS-claim, 3rd-party-audit-text).

legal_review_bot: Legal notified. ETA for review: 24 hours. Please add precise claim language to the ticket to speed it up.

finance_ops: Posted preliminary uplift calc in the ticket: +19% commit uplift, +estimated $0.02/GB/mo for immutable logs. Note this is preliminary; final SOW pricing needs sales approval.

julian_sales: Perfect. I'll confirm NDA status with Helios and push for countersign. If legal clears the two flagged items we'll send the packet.

omar_security: Once legal signs off I'll mark the thread resolved and update the ticket status to `ready_for_sales`.

julian_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll keep Helios updated: expecting full packet (redacted SOC2 + CAIQ answers + evidence links + SOW uplift) within ~48 hours. :thumbsup:

infra_poc: FYI — sample export command for logs to SIEM attached in the ticket for their security team to validate.

finance_ops: I'll stand by to finalize pricing once legal and infra confirm.

omar_security: Closing loop here — REDWOOD-SEC-4899 now contains draft answers, evidence, and outstanding legal flags. Ping me if Helios pushes earlier. :pray:
